services.name: Pickleball
services.desc: The KWPA and PCO Nationals Committee are recruiting juniors to compete in the Nationals. Coach Patricia will be coaching any Juniors who are interested in playing Pickleball in the Eastern Nationals July 12, 2015. Coaching will take place every Saturday night starting March 7, from 7:30-9:30pm. Patricia is not charging for coaching and K-W Badminton Club is generously donating the court time. Cost to participants is drop-in fee if you are not a member of the K-W Badminton Club. If you would like to participate, please contact Patricia at kwpickleballassociation@gmail.com. Looking forward to seeing you

services.name: Court Rental - 6 Courts
services.desc: As of July 19th 2021 the Club will be open for play on Monday, Wednesday and Friday evenings, and Sundays 10-3. Capacity is limited to 50 people, so first come first served, the door will be locked after that many people are in (at least until the end of Step 3 of the Provincial re-opening plan). The whiteboard sign-up system will be used again for the courts. Please note, we encourage anyone who has not been fully vaccinated to please do it, for the comfort and well-being of staff and other members. services.name: School Rental Program
services.desc: The K-W Badminton Club encourages badminton for students through our special discount program. We want to make our dedicated facility available to middle schools, high schools, and private schools for badminton instruction. The base rate is $5 per student, for one day or booking. But, we have a discount program that can reduce the price for schools to as low as $2.50/student/visit. Schools may pre-book our facility for any of their registered students and coaches/staff.
